answer.explanation: Throughout the 10-minute window the ThumbnailerFunction failed repeatedly with AccessDenied on s3:PutObject to lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi/thumbnailer/*, with the error stating that no identity-based policy allows the action. The role's only inline policy, app-policy, grants s3:GetObject on the input bucket and nothing else, so the write permission is missing. The other three functions logged only normal REPORT lines and no permission errors. I did not have a tool to read the IaC template, so I could not confirm whether the template intended to grant PutObject. The IAM layer is the failing layer regardless.
